message.text:
Tracing the memo creation call chain from the frontend hook to the SQL INSERT. The frontend hook is `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` (`useCreateMemo`).

The remaining five hops are:

- `web/src/connect.ts` (`memoServiceClient`)
- `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`CreateMemo`)
- `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (`APIV1Service.CreateMemo`)
- `store/memo.go` (`Store.CreateMemo`)
- `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (`DB.CreateMemo`)
I will list six hops, one per line, ending with a SQLite dialect driver.

q24.
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts
web/src/connect.ts
proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
store/memo.go
store/db/sqlite/memo.go

`useCreateMemo` in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo` from `web/src/connect.ts`, which maps to `rpc CreateMemo` in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`. `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls `Store.CreateMemo` in `store/memo.go`, which delegates to the dialect driver (SQLite `INSERT` is in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`).
